# Room 77

> Room 77 is a couples-only lifestyle brand run by Lauren and Richard: a long-running swinger and open-lifestyle podcast, curated couples-only events (FLIRT and SIN takeovers in Isla Mujeres, Mexico), and a travel desk that books lifestyle resorts and cruises (Desire Riviera Maya, Desire Pearl, Temptation Cancun, Hedonism II) at guaranteed rates, sometimes with cash back. All place names are written without Spanish accents (Mexico, Cancun, Riviera Maya) for search.
